subject: P18 built: ui654fb60dvfs 77718554, ui654fb60 c0c67193, probe350dvfs 5a22c9db (kernel p18a 4c1ffada)
body:
P18 BUILT (host-only, NOT run, NOT flashed; needs the user's approval). One kernel p18a (series 0085..0116, includes everything of P15-P17: 0112 reservation, 0113, MCUPM probes + ping behind their own boot-args) sha256 4c1ffada2d0b8be6b2cdfabd55c9fb8972b62a86d1df9b6a3e1994b3605d2526; images under gpu/build/device-mmu-p18-candidate/:
- ui654fb60dvfs  7771855474afd511a4f718b68cd18370ee1938521265b5994cdb66c83d7dae52  (UI, cmdline 607 chars = the limit, "n2fbhz=60 n2dvfs=2000")
- ui654fb60      c0c6719397ffb534f1f579ec35216eefe9a8d13e22c93fe70dbd7e33f4bf4d60  (the same UI without DVFS, fallback, 595 chars)
- probe350dvfs   5a22c9db7e4d0983cc42f199534a2a221f4120b84c44483bc653b91380afc4de  (probe350 base, "n2dvfs=1" = phase A: platform init + pinned hand-over, no frequency change, 594 chars)
Patch 0116-cpu-dvfs-bringup-n2dvfs.patch 86f66e77ebf0d978 (bsd/dev/nord2_dvfs.h = engine, nord2_cpuhvfs_init.h + tables, nord2_cpufreq.c glue, Nord2GPU.cpp: new read-only export nord2_pmic_read for the init voltages); candidate-gpu-source-0116.patch 4105e7c89bdf80a4 = the same Nord2GPU.cpp change for gpu/src + shim/nord2-xnu (NOT applied to the repo; run_all applies it to its copy; root applies it at the next kernel-source sync).
Order at boot+60 s, every step prints a NORD2 DVFS line, every unexpected reply/measurement -> fallback (limits+requests of LL/L/B back to the bootloader rows, then stop, nothing sent again): 0 preflight (sends/stores NOTHING: clocks in the bootloader window LL 1700-1900 / L,B 650-800 MHz, all 4 rails readable and inside the platform clamps, share buffer OK) -> 1 platform init {0x504C5401, 0x70000000, 0x200000} on mailbox 0, reply must be exactly 1 -> 2 pinned CSRAM plan (table/CCI map/limits=requests=bootloader rows LL 1 (1800) / L 14 (700) / B 15 (659), request window never written with 0), full readback, cmd 0, cmd 10 x4 with freshly read rails, cmd 1 level 1, clocks re-measured (unchanged or at the pinned row) -> 3 ramp L and B one row at a time to the cap rows (cap 2000: L row 4 = 1985, B row 7 = 1998 MHz; LL stays 1800), each row must measure within 8 % before the next, battery gauge: no step at >=40.0 C or unreadable gauge, tick: >=43.0 C one row slower, <38.0 C one row faster -> 4 placement mode 0xf as soon as the big cores measure >=105 % of the A55s (back to 0 below 95 %), not if n2sch= is set.
Share buffer (mcupm_share 2 MiB): fixed physical 0x70000000 (free first-bank DRAM; the IPI word is 32 bit and the XNU pool is above 4 GiB), mapped device memory, stock header written and read back; n2d_share_ok refuses anything overlapping any mblock of the live FDT, loader/stock kernel/payload window, Wi-Fi CONN/DMA pool, framebuffer, TEE, MCUPM region.
Risks for the approval: first CSRAM stores ever, first DVFS-channel doorbells, first frequency change (L/B briefly go to their pinned rows 700/659 MHz = 4 %/10 % below the bootloader clock before the ramp); the voltages are the firmware's from the stock table; unknowns: the firmware's reply words for cmds 0/10/1 (logged, success judged by the clocks), the CCI request rule (assumption, vendor CCI map), whether the hand-over works without the mailbox-3 handshake, gauge = only temperature input. README-0107-design.md section 13. Tests: nord2_dvfs_test (fake MCUPM/CSRAM/rails/clocks/gauge; every abort path; 12 engine mutations fail it), cpuhvfs init/tables tests, scan helpers; run_all.sh gate on the P18 stage is queued behind another agent's cargo build and will be reported when it ends. Stopping here as asked.
